input: Join a local community choir this fall

gold.taskTitle: Join a local community choir this fall
gold.taskDescription: Find and successfully join a local community choir before or during the fall season.

questions.title: What city or neighborhood should the choir be in?
questions.description: Identify the geographic area where the user wants to find a choir.

questions.title: Do you have a preferred voice part or range?
questions.description: Determine if the user sings soprano, alto, tenor, bass, or is unsure of their voice type.

questions.title: What is your current choral or singing experience level?
questions.description: Understand whether the user is a complete beginner, has some experience, or is a seasoned singer.

questions.title: Do you want a choir that requires an audition?
questions.description: Clarify whether the user is open to audition-based choirs or prefers a no-audition, open-enrollment group.

questions.title: What days or times are you available to rehearse?
questions.description: Identify the user's weekly schedule constraints so rehearsal times can be matched accordingly.

questions.title: Is there a specific musical style you want to sing?
questions.description: Find out if the user has a preference such as classical, gospel, pop, jazz, or is open to any genre.

questions.title: What does 'this fall' mean as a start deadline for you?
questions.description: Pin down a specific month or date by which the user wants to have joined and started rehearsing.
